definitions.explanation: A person who buys popular or limited items and resells them at a higher price for profit. The term carries a negative connotation, implying unfair or exploitative behavior.

examples.japanese: {転売|てんばい}ヤー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I can't buy tickets because of scalpers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定品|げんていひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{転売|てんばい}ヤー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{占|し}められた→買い占める：15550_kaishimeru⟧。
examples.english: The limited-edition items were bought up by resellers.

examples.japanese: {転売|てんばい}ヤー⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: As a measure against scalpers, a limit of one item per person was put in place.

notes:
USAGE:
A colloquial term combining ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧ (resale) with the suffix ヤー (from English '-er'). Strongly negative, used to criticize people who buy up popular goods to resell at inflated prices. Common targets include concert tickets, limited-edition goods, and popular electronics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転売|てんばい}ヤー⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (anti-scalper measures)
- {転売|てんばい}ヤー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{占|し}められる→買い占める：15550_kaishimeru⟧ (to be bought up by scalpers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}{屋|や}→転売屋：24325_tenbaiya⟧: same meaning, slightly more traditional phrasing
